name: reachinbox-scheduler-monorepo
description: Production-grade Full-stack Email Job Scheduler (ReachInbox / Outbox Labs)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WORKER,WEB" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/worker" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
